caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four turned legs, a single central drawer, and drop leaves on either side, rendered in light brown and beige tones with fine pencil outlines and shading. The table drawer has a round decorative knob with a floral motif, and a detailed, circular close-up of this knob is drawn at the lower right corner of the composition, showing the petal pattern clearly. A scale runs horizontally along the bottom edge, marked with measurements, and the artist’s name “Edith N. Magonette” is written in the lower left corner. The entire drawing is centered on a blank, off-white background.
title: Sheraton Table
